up: Return the exact activity values and structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649959. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units for the activity. Provide the canonical SMILES from the compound structures.
sql: SELECT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649959'
